//: This config type-checks goblin-forge's *own* TypeScript — the compiler.
Goblin programs are not in it, and must not be: they are checked against
packages/runtime/global.d.ts under `noLib`, which is a different language
with a different global surface. `examples/*/src` is excluded for exactly
that reason, and so is `tests/oracle/cases`, whose `.gf.ts` files are the
Goblin half of the C++ oracle. `examples/*/build.ts` is included, because
a build script is ordinary TypeScript that imports this compiler.
